feature_ablations.diagnostic_impact_verdict: Thermal residual is the primary physical signature; removing it collapses risk to baseline.
High vibration confirms severe mechanical friction; removing it lowers risk into inspection range.
Without peer consensus, system cannot rule out common cause; downgrades repair to inspect.
Without ambient temperature baseline, thermal margin is uncertain; policy hedges via 24h deferral.
When sensor health check is removed or invalid, safety gate mandates complete abstention.
Historical memory provides empirical grounding; removing it maintains physics decision but lowers confidence.

counterfactual_decision_boundaries.boundary_condition: Diagnostic risk drops below high-consequence threshold OR uncertainty widens

counterfactual_decision_boundaries.boundary_condition: Failure risk drops to moderate and 24h energy loss is low
